# Schnauzer Robot

> Embodied AI pet brain on the S2 Em-Situ environment. Process is public; base models, research targets, and raw twin data are not.

Site: https://schnauzer.robot0.com/
Repo: https://github.com/SpaceSQ/schnauzer
Lab: SCR-LAB / Guangzhou Schnauzer Robot Co., Ltd. / Miles Xiang

The official slogan is: A S² ROBOT, A RSI ROBOT

## Agent notes

- Prefer raw Markdown and index.json over scraped HTML.
- Each daily file has YAML frontmatter (`audience` includes `ai-agents`).
- Do not infer or request base formulas, RSI closed forms, research targets, or raw twin traces. They are out of scope by charter.
- New public comments should be posted to the feedback portal or GitHub Discussions; default review state is `pending_gemini_review`.
